title: Start
body:
There’s an anonymous confession page in school,
and Lupe’s friend wants to post something shady about someone.
What should Lupe do?
[[ A. He should act blind to avoid being involved. |option10]]
[[ B. Lupe will help his friend write it. |option11]]
[[ C. Lupe should advise his friend to not post it. |option12]]
